title: Keep the seeded-demo test fixture out of a plain /grade agent-spec
item: Stop grade.py's all-labels run from grading results/seeded-demo, the hand-written build2 fixture of the grader tests, as if it were a trial
motivation: With build2 live in grading.json, every run of grade.py eval/agent-spec without --set or --labels grades every results/ folder, seeded-demo included. Two callers do this: a bare /grade agent-spec, which writes results/seeded-demo/judge/key_recall.task.md and would dispatch a paid judge on invented numbers, and /iterate step 1, which runs plain grade.py eval/<skill> for the advisor's table, so it writes the same file and hands the advisor a seeded-demo row that FAILs on lint_errors (1 > 0), one_path_share (0.83 against the baseline worst of 1.0) and guard_recommend (0.75 < 1.0); key_recall is ungated and shows pending. Both runs also rewrite results/switch-smoke-1/judge/key_recall.task.md (same content today). Only /trial and /iterate step 5 pass --set and are not affected
notes: Found while building task 028. switch-smoke-1 is a real smoke trial, not a fixture; whether a plain run should also leave it alone is a separate call for the owner, and done_means covers seeded-demo only. results/ is append-only, so the fixture cannot simply be moved or relabelled there; options are an exclusion list read by grade.py or moving the fixture with its tests. 2026-11-16, owner's decision in chat: neither folder was needed in results/, so both were removed instead of changing grade.py. seeded-demo moved to new-format/grader/tests/fixtures/ and the grader tests copy it into a temporary eval folder; switch-smoke-1 deleted (recoverable from commit 2fbdb77). Done by Claude in chat in one commit, outside a manager run, because a task branch cannot delete under results/. Correction to the motivation above: --set runs were affected too; grade.py grades every results/ folder whatever --set says. Checked after the change: grader tests 34 of 34; grade.py eval/agent-spec, plain and with --set switch-base, prints no seeded-demo row and lists 0 judge tasks.
done_means: grade.py eval/agent-spec with no labels does not grade seeded-demo and writes no file under results/seeded-demo/; the grader tests still pass.
draft_note: Drafted by the task-028 builder. may_edit left empty: the fix needs a choice between grade.py and the grader tests, which is the owner's. Priority left for the owner.
